description:
2016 Audi Q5 Premium Plus: The Gold Standard of Compact Luxury

The 2016 Audi Q5 Premium Plus stands as a landmark in the luxury crossover segment. Even years after its debut, it remains a masterclass in balancing athletic performance with an understated, executive elegance that never goes out of style.

Engineering Excellence: The 2.0T & Quattro

Under the hood, the 2016 Q5 features the highly acclaimed 2.0-liter turbocharged four-cylinder engine, producing a smooth and responsive 220 horsepower and 258 lb-ft of torque.

Legendary Traction: Standard quattro all-wheel drive is the heart of this vehicle. It provides an unmatched sense of confidence, whether you’re navigating a rain-slicked highway or a winding mountain pass. The power delivery is seamless, ensuring grip and stability in all conditions.

Refined Gearbox: The 8-speed Tiptronic automatic transmission is a highlight, offering buttery-smooth shifts that prioritize passenger comfort while remaining quick enough to satisfy a spirited driver.

The Premium Plus Experience

The Premium Plus trim is the sweet spot of the 2016 lineup, adding a suite of high-end features that elevate every journey.

Luxurious Appointments: Stepping inside reveals a cabin defined by Audi’s less is more philosophy. High-quality leather seating, genuine wood inlays, and soft-touch materials create a serene environment.

Convenience & Comfort: Standard features like heated front seats with memory settings, a panoramic sunroof that floods the cabin with natural light, and tri-zone automatic climate control ensure every passenger feels like a VIP.

Audi Advanced Key: The convenience of keyless start, stop, and entry makes the daily commute effortless.

Tech and Sound

Audi’s attention to detail extends to the sensory experience.

Bang & Olufsen Audio: Many Premium Plus models come equipped with the spectacular B&O sound system, which remains one of the best in the industry for clarity and depth.

MMI Interface: The Multi Media Interface is intuitive and tactile, allowing you to control navigation and media without taking your eyes off the road.

Timeless Design

Visually, the 2016 Q5 is a triumph of proportion. With its signature LED daytime running lights, elegant roof rails, and standard 19-inch wheels, it possesses a muscular yet sophisticated silhouette that looks just as modern today as it did on the showroom floor.

Verdict

The 2016 Audi Q5 Premium Plus is the perfect vehicle for those who refuse to compromise. It offers the utility of an SUV with the driving dynamics of a sport sedan and the interior quality of a flagship luxury car. It is a reliable, beautiful, and immensely capable companion for any lifestyle.

description: The 2021 Chevrolet Spark LS CVT offers a compact, efficient, and stylish ride perfect for city driving and daily commutes. With just over 39,200 miles, this Silver Ice Metallic hatchback combines practicality with modern tech features to keep you connected on the go. Its 1.4-liter four-cylinder engine delivers 98 horsepower, providing enough power while maintaining impressive fuel economy—30 mpg in the city and 38 mpg on the highway. The FWD drivetrain ensures confident handling, and the four-door layout makes access easy for four passengers. Inside, the Jet Black interior offers a sleek, comfortable space that complements the vehicle’s exterior. Whether you're navigating tight streets or parking in crowded areas, this Spark is designed to deliver a nimble, reliable driving experience. Equipped with essential connectivity features, this Chevrolet Spark keeps you in touch and entertained. Apple CarPlay seamlessly integrates your iPhone for easy access to navigation, music, and messaging, while Bluetooth enables hands-free calling and audio streaming. The included Wi-Fi hotspot ensures your devices stay connected, ideal for work or entertainment on the move. The 7-inch touchscreen infotainment system acts as the command hub, offering a user-friendly interface for media, apps, and vehicle settings. The vehicle also supports Amazon Alexa integration, allowing voice control for compatible smart devices and services. For audio enjoyment, Pandora provides internet radio access, and auxiliary USB input offers additional media options. Electronic messaging assistance features include voice-operated and read functions, enhancing safety and convenience during your drive. 2021 Chevrolet Spark Safety and Security Features This Spark prioritizes safety with dual front knee airbags that help protect occupants in a collision. The vehicle is equipped with four-wheel anti-lock braking system (ABS), which enhances braking control and stability, especially in emergency situations. These safety features work together to provide peace of mind for drivers and passengers alike, making this hatchback a reliable choice for everyday transportation. 2021 Chevrolet Spark Entertainment and Technology Features This vehicle’s entertainment and tech suite includes a 7-inch touch screen display that serves as the control center for media and connectivity. Compatibility with myChevrolet app and Connected Access offers remote vehicle management and diagnostic information, while voice-operated systems for hands-free calls and electronic messaging ensure your focus remains on the road. Amazon Alexa integration allows voice commands for smart home and music controls, adding a layer of convenience. The infotainment system also supports Pandora internet radio, USB auxiliary input, and app marketplace access, providing a rich array of entertainment options to enhance your driving experience.

Porsche Marin is pleased to present this exceptional Taycan 4S, finished in sophisticated Volcano Grey Metallic over a distinctive Leather-Free Race-Tex Interior in Black with Pepita Seat Centers. This highly specified all-electric sports sedan delivers an exhilarating blend of cutting-edge performance, advanced technology, and unmistakable Porsche design.

Volcano Grey Metallic provides a sleek and modern presence, perfectly complemented by 21" Mission E Design Wheels and All-Season Tires for year-round versatility. High Gloss Black exterior accents, including the window trim and model designation on the rear, enhance the Taycans clean and performance-focused aesthetic, while the Fixed Panoramic Roof in Glass adds an open and airy feel to the cabin.

Performance is elevated with the Performance Battery Plus, offering extended range and enhanced power delivery, while the Sport Chrono Package with Push to Pass provides an extra burst of acceleration when desired. Porsche InnoDrive with Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC) and Active Lane Keep (ALK) delivers intelligent driver assistance for both spirited drives and long-distance comfort.

Inside, the cabin reflects a modern and sustainable approach with the Race-Tex interior and iconic Pepita seat centers, paired with Interior Accents in Neodyme for a refined contrast. Comfort Seats (14-way) with Memory Package ensure excellent support, while Ventilated Front Seats and Heated Rear Seats provide comfort for all occupants. The Rear 2+1 Seating configuration adds practicality without compromising the Taycans sporty character.

The Premium Package enhances everyday usability with features such as a Head-Up Display, BOSE Surround Sound System, Soft Close Doors, and an advanced Air Quality System. Surround View with Active Parking Support ensures confidence in tight spaces, while the Storage Package adds thoughtful practicality for daily use.

This Taycan 4S represents the perfect balance of electric performance, luxury, and innovation and outstanding opportunity for the forward-thinking Porsche enthusiast.

Porsche Marin, a member of the indiGO Auto Group, invites you to experience this exceptional vehicle in person. For additional information or to schedule a private consultation, please contact lcouncil@porschemarin.com or visit us at 900 Redwood Hwy, Mill Valley, CA 94941.

description: 2023 Cadillac CT5-V Blackwing — the uncompromising, track-bred grand tourer for those who demand supercar ferocity wrapped in American luxury. This particular specimen arrives in a head-turning Blaze Orange Metallic exterior, complemented by Jet Black Alcantara and premium leather interior with the Sueded Microfiber Interior Trim Package, and it has been sparingly used — under 2,000 miles total (averaging less than 1,000 miles per year). A clean CARFAX completes the picture: immaculate provenance to match immaculate condition. Power & Performance - Heart of a beast: 6.2L supercharged V8 producing an earth-shaking 668 hp and 659 ft-lbs of torque. Every press of the accelerator is an event — explosive throttle response, thunderous exhaust note, and supercar acceleration when commanded. - Track-ready chassis and hardware straight from Cadillac’s V engineers: a performance-tuned adaptive suspension system, high-performance Brembo braking hardware with multi-piston calipers (now highlighted in Bronze Caliper finish), and an advanced limited-slip differential that keeps the power where it belongs. - Driver-centric performance controls: selectable drive modes and launch control for precise, repeatable launches and turn-in behavior tailored from smooth street cruising to full track aggression. - Real-world economy where expected for a hyper-performance sedan: EPA-rated at 13 MPG city and 21 MPG highway. Exterior - Blaze Orange Metallic paintwork announces your arrival with unparalleled presence — a factory-applied finish that’s bold, lustrous, and unmistakably exclusive. - 19-inch aluminum alloy wheels with Tech Bronze finish lend a cohesive, purposeful look, matched to the Bronze Accent Package that adds complementary bronze detailing across the exterior. - Bronze Calipers provide a finishing touch that ties together form and function — the unmistakable visual cue of serious stopping power. - Ultraview sunroof floods the cabin with light and sky, enhancing the drama and luxury of every drive. Interior & Comfort - Jet Black Alcantara and premium leather seats provide the perfect balance of support and refinement: grippy, breathable Alcantara where you need it for performance driving, and sumptuous leather for long-distance comfort. - Sueded Microfiber Interior Trim Package elevates tactile quality throughout the cabin, adding soft-touch surfaces that feel bespoke and durable. - The cockpit is driver-oriented and purpose-built: supportive bolstered seating, clear performance instrumentation, and ergonomics designed to keep your focus on the road and the track. Technology & Convenience - A full complement of factory-integrated systems to keep you connected and confident: advanced infotainment with smartphone integration, intuitive controls, and premium materials that underscore Cadillac luxury. - The Parking Package augments daily usability and safety with factory-installed parking aids — sensors and camera enhancements that make maneuvering this potent machine around town effortless and secure. Condition & Provenance - Excellent overall condition, showing the careful stewardship expected of a low-mileage, nearly new performance flagship. - Clean CARFAX report — no blemishes on its record and an ownership history that reflects thoughtful use. This 2023 CT5-V Blackwing is more than a sedan — it’s a statement of intent. With monumental supercharged V8 power, precision engineering, sumptuous Jet Black Alcantara/leather comforts, bespoke Bronze accents, a luminous Blaze Orange finish, and the confidence of a pristine CARFAX, this is a rare opportunity to own a modern American performance legend with almost new mileage. If you seek an uncompromising union of luxury and track capability, this Blackwing answers with thunder.

Blending cutting-edge technology with unmistakable BMW craftsmanship, this i7 delivers an elevated driving experience unlike anything else on the road.Designed to make a bold statement, this i7 is equipped with the M Sport Package and M Sport Professional Package, enhancing both its athletic stance and dynamic presence. Features such as extended Shadowline trim, carbon fiber interior accents, M Sport exterior and interior elements, and M Sport brakes with black calipers give this luxury sedan a performance-inspired edge. The signature illuminated kidney grille and 20-inch M bi-color wheels complete its commanding and futuristic design.Inside, the cabin is nothing short of extraordinary. Crafted with extended Merino leather upholstery and premium materials throughout, this interior offers an environment of pure refinement. Enjoy multi-functional front seats with massage functionality, heated and ventilated front and rear seats, heated armrests, and a heated steering wheel, ensuring every passenger experiences ultimate comfort regardless of the season. Rear passengers are equally pampered with spacious seating, rear climate controls, and luxury amenities designed for long-distance travel.Technology is seamlessly integrated into every aspect of the i7. The BMW Live Cockpit Pro with advanced navigation system provides a fully digital and intuitive interface, while natural interaction technology allows for voice and gesture-based controls. The Bowers & Wilkins surround sound system delivers an immersive, concert-quality audio experience, perfectly complementing the vehicles ultra-quiet electric cabin. Connectivity is effortless with Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, enhanced Bluetooth, and a built-in personal eSIM 5G connection, keeping you fully connected at all times.Equipped with the Driving Assistance Professional Package, this i7 offers a suite of advanced safety and semi-autonomous features, including Active Driving Assistant Pro and Highway Assistant, designed to reduce driver fatigue and enhance confidence on longer journeys. The Premium Package further elevates convenience with Active Cruise Control with Stop & Go, Parking Assistant Professional, and a Surround View Camera system with 3D View, making city driving and parking effortless.Performance is both smooth and exhilarating thanks to its advanced all-electric drivetrain paired with adaptive air suspension, delivering instant torque, near-silent operation, and exceptional ride quality. The precision engineering ensures a balanced and composed driving experience whether cruising at highway speeds or navigating urban environments.Additional premium features include a heads-up display, wireless device charging, rear window blinds, memory settings, and a full suite of intelligent safety systems, all designed to enhance convenience, comfort, and peace of mind.If you're searching for a BMW i7 for sale, an electric luxury sedan with M Sport styling, or a flagship EV that delivers next-level technology and comfort, this 2025 BMW i7 xDrive60 exceeds expectations in every category.Refined, powerful, and forward-thinking, this is the future of luxury driving.

That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.

Safety and Security
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.

It uses the speed of the brake pedal's travel to sense panic braking, then applies all available power to boost your stopping power. Brake assist can stop the accident before it is one.
Technology and Telematics
